name: auto-dl-loop
description: An adversarial two-machine research task: a worker builds the deliverable, a validator judges it against a benchmark that only grows.

worker.description: The machine that researches and builds, round after round, and submits to the validator.
next: Set the validator machine up first: configured, its workflow set up and its service running. Then configure this one with its configure loop (in the Studio, pick configure in the list above the canvas and press Run; or claude "Run the configure loop"): it connects to the validator and fetches task.md. Then set up the workflow with setup (normally research-iteration), and try it with loop-trial before the real rounds.

validator.description: The machine that reviews each submission against the benchmark and the hidden tests, and publishes the result.
next: Configure this machine with its configure loop (in the Studio, pick configure in the list above the canvas and press Run; or claude "Run the configure loop"): task.md, the benchmark, the terms and the service. Then set up the workflow with setup (normally submission-review), and start the service the configuration's report names.
